verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy is a fair axis for a framework, but the evidence pack contains no documented deprecation policy or API versioning guarantees. Codemods for upgrading when new features are released and the Pages-to-App Router upgrade guide are adjacent migration tooling, not a stated deprecation policy. The openapi.json probe shows only that a spec file exists, not that the APIs are versioned or have a deprecation schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
